title: Balancing Loops
hook: Change anything and something pushes back. That's the system, not failure.
statement: Systems resist change. Bigger changes get bigger pushback.
explainer: Teams and habits snap back. Cut the friction instead of adding pressure.
equation_example: Desired 9 - Current 4 = Gap 5. Big gap, big resistance. Shrinking gap means it's sticking.
question: Name one friction you'll remove instead of pushing harder.
closing_statement: Resistance scales with how far you push.
